changelog:
Initial release of clawec-shopee-item-hotword.

- Enables querying Shopee hot search words (drain words/category hotwords) for up to 10 item IDs via the Clawec API.
- Returns key data fields such as search index, recent 30-day sales and GMV, and recommended bid.
- Supports all Shopee sites (tw, my, id, th, ph, sg, vn, br) with easy API authentication.
- Provides clear output: scope, conditions, hotwords table, keyword opportunities, and prioritized recommendations.
- Batch requests supported when exceeding 10 item IDs.
summary: 通过 Clawec API 查询 Shopee 商品热搜词（引流词/同类目热词，含搜索指数、近30天销量销售额、推荐出价）。在用户需要虾皮热搜词、引流词分析、同类目热词、SEO/广告选词时使用。
